Railway Gazette reported in February 2007 that the pair were rebuilding the line under a US$175 million concession awarded in 2004.

It carried out the resettlement and the environmental clean-up, and it and the independent engineer intervened several times on safety, as far as expelling managers, stopping work and closing workers' camps.

appears_on.role: Built the four substations under a single-source contract approved by the European Investment Bank. The completion report says the Palestinian Authority and EIB concluded that only this company could effectively build the substations in the West Bank, because of the complexity of the approval processes from the Israeli authorities and the need to deal with them, and that it took from May 2008 to October 2010 to agree contract terms, partly because the company had no obvious interest in speeding up construction, which would cut its short-term electricity sales to the West Bank (completion report, paragraph 25).
